title: Alliance Enum
instructions:
Complete the `Alliance` enum class so it has two constants: `RED` and `BLUE`.

Then complete the `describeAlliance` function. It should use a `when` expression to return:
- `"Red Alliance: Go score some points!"` when the alliance is `RED`
- `"Blue Alliance: Let's win this match!"` when the alliance is `BLUE`
hint: Put RED and BLUE inside the enum body separated by a comma. In the when expression, match on Alliance.RED and Alliance.BLUE.
